title: Legitimate conversation
summary: An ordinary call between friends. Nothing suspicious is asked for.

events.text: Hi, it's Maya. Are we still on for dinner on Saturday?

events.speaker: you

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Maybe a dessert. I'll send you the address by message this afternoon.

events.speaker: you
events.text: Perfect. By the way, can we move the study meeting to three o'clock tomorrow?
